w1.situation: I work in retail management and want to move into data science. A one-year master's costs about £30,000, which I would borrow, and I haven't done any coding or data work yet.
w1.plan: The plan is to enrol for the course starting in September and take out the loan.
w1.A_hi: I know what I want from a career in data science, and I have settled on this myself.
w1.A_lo: I cannot judge whether a master's and this loan suit me, so I will go along with it.

w1.D_lo: I rarely bring career or money decisions to you, so asking about this is unusual for me.
